seoTitle: Accessible HTML Table Builder from CSV with Caption and Scope
metaDescription: Turn CSV or tab-separated data into an HTML table with caption, thead, th scope headers and an optional keyboard-reachable scroll wrapper.
intro: Builds an accessible HTML table from pasted CSV with caption and scope attributes.
why:
Tables without headers are read cell by cell with no context.

This tool detects the delimiter, handles quoted fields, escapes the content, adds a caption, marks column headers and an optional header column with scope, and can wrap the table in a labelled, focusable scroll region. Complex tables with merged cells need manual markup.
howTo: Choose whether the first column is a header.

faq.a: It tells assistive technology which cells a header applies to.
So keyboard users can scroll a table that overflows.
No. Use colspan, rowspan and scope="colgroup" by hand.
